name: Braintree
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Braintree, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Braintree, MA: the Festival of Trees and tree lighting at Town Hall, Santa at the firehouse and the Atlantic Symphony's holiday concert.
lede: Braintree's Christmas gathers at Town Hall, where a community tree lighting goes with four days of the Festival of Trees, and at Thayer's Center for the Arts, home of the Atlantic Symphony Orchestra's holiday concert.
celebrates: Braintree's holiday season centers on Town Hall on JFK Memorial Drive. An outdoor community tree lighting goes with Braintree's Festival of Trees, a four day raffle of more than 50 themed trees donated by local businesses, organizations and residents, with holiday music, refreshments and special appearances inside Town Hall. One festival day is set aside for families and first responders, with Santa, cocoa, cookies and crafts at the Braintree Firehouse, a Holiday Stroll to Town Hall and a Touch a Truck display. Across town, the Atlantic Symphony Orchestra holds its annual holiday celebration at Thayer's Center for the Arts, with Nutcracker music and a sing along.
lastyear: In 2025 the Braintree Tree Lighting took place outside Town Hall on Thursday, December 4, and the Festival of Trees invited families on Instagram to head inside right afterward for the festival's first night. The Patriot Ledger described the free festivities as beginning with the outdoor tree lighting at 5 pm, followed by four days of decorated trees that visitors could win by raffle, with the money going to local causes.
facts: Braintree's Festival of Trees is a 501(c)(3) charitable foundation that is independent from the Town of Braintree, and its committee is made up entirely of volunteers. Donors set up their trees at Town Hall in the two days before the doors open. The festival has paid for the holiday lights on Town Hall and Thayer Public Library, and it stepped in to help a Braintree resident and his father who lost everything in a house fire.
trains: Braintree station, at 197 Ivory Street, is where Red Line trains marked Braintree finish their run, and it is also a stop on the Kingston and Fall River/New Bedford Commuter Rail lines. The Braintree Garage has more than 1,100 spaces and costs $3 on weekends, an easy start for a train day with kids. Farther south, Edaville in Carver runs a Holiday Express through its lights, and the Old Colony and Fall River Railroad Museum shows more than 240 feet of model track.

kidfact: At Braintree's Festival of Trees, more than 50 decorated Christmas trees fill Town Hall, and every single one is a raffle prize that a family can take home.
faq: What is Braintree's Festival of Trees?

It is a four day community event at Braintree Town Hall with a raffle of more than 50 uniquely themed and decorated trees donated by local businesses, organizations and residents. The festival adds holiday music, refreshments, special appearances and raffle prizes, and the money it raises goes back to people and projects in Braintree.
Where is the Braintree tree lighting?

Outside Braintree Town Hall, 1 John F Kennedy Memorial Drive. In 2025 the tree lighting was on Thursday, December 4, at 5 pm, and the Festival of Trees opened inside right afterward, so families could see the lights and then walk in to look at the decorated trees.
Who runs the Festival of Trees in Braintree?

A committee made up entirely of volunteers runs it as a 501(c)(3) charitable foundation that is independent from the Town of Braintree. Clean Harbors is the presenting sponsor, and the festival has used its money for things like holiday lights on Town Hall and help for residents after a house fire.
Where does the Atlantic Symphony Orchestra play in Braintree?

At Thayer's Center for the Arts, 745 Washington Street. The orchestra holds its annual holiday celebration there with Nutcracker music, seasonal favorites and a sing along, and its season also includes an all ages Discovery Concert with Peter and the Wolf. Parking at the venue is free.

Braintree station at 197 Ivory Street. It is the end of the Red Line's Braintree branch and a stop on the Kingston and Fall River/New Bedford Commuter Rail lines. The Braintree Garage has more than 1,100 spaces and charges $3 on weekends, so it works well for a family trip into Boston.
